WITH yearly AS ( SELECT c_mktsegment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE c_acctbal > 2500 GROUP BY c_mktsegment, yr ) SELECT c_mktsegment, yr, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY yr) AS prev_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY yr)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY yr), 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM yearly ORDER BY c_mktsegment, yr;
